articles.author: Denise Chow
articles.title: A near-total lunar eclipse will be visible across the U.S. Thursday night - NBC News
articles.description: Two weeks after a total solar eclipse wowed skywatchers in Europe, a near-total lunar eclipse is in store Thursday for people in North and South America.
articles.content:
Two weeks after a total solar eclipse wowed skywatchers in southern Europe, a near-total lunar eclipse is set to put on a show Thursday night for people across North and South America.
